benchmarks.title: Premium fintech SaaS dashboard
benchmarks.brief: Reconcile overdue invoices for a small finance team.
benchmarks.required: Search, status filter, recoverable empty state, clear currency and due dates.
benchmarks.constraints: No real customer data or invented performance claims.

benchmarks.title: Luxury fashion landing page
benchmarks.brief: Explain a three-piece capsule collection and lead to product detail.
benchmarks.required: Material, sizing, price and availability remain discoverable on mobile.
benchmarks.constraints: Use only supplied/licensed images; mark example product information.

benchmarks.title: Minimalist portfolio
benchmarks.brief: Present three architectural concept studies and the designer's role.
benchmarks.required: Readable case studies and a working contact route.
benchmarks.constraints: No fabricated client outcomes; long project titles must wrap.

benchmarks.title: Brutalist creative agency
benchmarks.brief: Present independent studio work with an unconventional but navigable composition.
benchmarks.required: Project navigation, readable case content, keyboard focus.

benchmarks.title: Maximalist entertainment
benchmarks.brief: Help visitors explore a three-day music program.
benchmarks.required: Working day filter, venue/access details, clear pass information.
benchmarks.constraints: No flashing; reduced-motion page remains complete.

benchmarks.title: Startup homepage
benchmarks.brief: Explain a scheduling product to operations managers.
benchmarks.required: Product workflow, clear next step and credible limits.
benchmarks.constraints: No invented logos, testimonials or growth metrics.

benchmarks.title: Editorial magazine
benchmarks.brief: Publish a feature essay with two related stories.
benchmarks.required: Readable long-form measure, captioned imagery, article navigation.
benchmarks.constraints: Preserve semantic order and zoom readability.

benchmarks.title: E-commerce product detail
benchmarks.brief: Help a visitor compare sizes and choose a handmade chair finish.
benchmarks.required: Variant selection, availability, delivery and price.
benchmarks.constraints: No simulated payment success without an actual backend.

benchmarks.title: Enterprise analytics
benchmarks.brief: Help a team investigate a change in support demand.
benchmarks.required: Filterable data, time range, units and a chart data alternative.
benchmarks.constraints: Show loading/error/empty; no ungrounded causal explanations.

benchmarks.title: Cinematic product story
benchmarks.brief: Explain a portable audio device through three meaningful product chapters.
benchmarks.required: User-controlled progression and a static reduced-motion alternative.
benchmarks.constraints: No scroll hijacking; avoid requiring 3D for product facts.

benchmarks.title: Mobile-first consumer application
benchmarks.brief: Help a neighborhood group browse and save local activities.
benchmarks.required: Browse, filter, save, empty state and keyboard access.
benchmarks.constraints: Retro is an optional trial direction; compare fit rather than assuming it.

benchmarks.title: Existing-site redesign
benchmarks.brief: Improve a deliberately weak but functional invoice workspace.
benchmarks.required: Preserve routes, fixtures and filtering behavior; compare before/after.
benchmarks.constraints: Baseline must come from the same independent generation protocol, not a sabotaged page.
